objects.title: Noodles GPU V1.0 — Interactive VR
objects.description: Original Marco Fugaro GPU noodle solver, adapted for Quest 3 native WebGPU passthrough. Pull individual strands with the trigger, move and resize the bundle with Zelda v13 grips. Eight strands by default, optional gravity; Quest testing pending.
objects.author: Marco Fugaro

objects.title: Noodles GPU V1.1 — Tabletop Physics
objects.description: Compact pile of GPU-simulated noodles on a visible wooden table. Always-on gravity, finite tabletop and leg collision geometry, trigger grabs and shared Zelda controls. Quest testing pending.
objects.author: Marco Fugaro

objects.title: Noodles GPU V1.2 — Two-Hand Interaction
objects.description: Independent two-controller noodle grabs in the same GPU collision simulation. Gravity unchanged; increased friction, damping and controlled separation for heavier-feeling, less slippery noodles. Tabletop and Zelda v13 grips retained.
objects.author: Marco Fugaro

objects.title: Discobolus GPU V1.0 — Gold in VR
objects.description: Original opaque muted-blue immersive studio with GPU Gray–Scott gold relief. Owner confirmed both Balanced and Original Fine modes work on Quest 3 on 27 November 2026.
objects.author: Marco Fugaro (original demo and simulation)

hardwareVerification.scope: Original immersive VR experience, both mesh quality settings

objects.title: Discobolus GPU V1.1 — VR & Passthrough
objects.description: Original blue studio plus optional native WebGPU mixed reality. Both mesh qualities, marble/gold lighting, painting and Zelda controls preserved. New passthrough mode awaits Quest testing.
objects.author: Marco Fugaro (original demo and simulation)

objects.title: Light & Debris GPU V1.0 — VR & Passthrough
objects.description: Owner-confirmed working independent native WebGPU light-driven metallic debris simulation with 8,000–150,000 fragments, dual controller beams, dark VR and mixed reality; shared Zelda v13 grips. Individual preset test coverage not specified.

ownerVerification.scope: Owner reported V1.0 working successfully; specific device, environment and GPU presets were not stated in this feedback.

objects.title: Light & Debris GPU V1.1 — Spatial Audio
objects.description: Preserves V1.0 GPU simulation and presets; adds two spatial trigger lasers, quiet procedural ambient sound and sampled GPU fragment-contact crystal chimes. Independent audio volume controls; Quest testing pending.

ownerVerification.scope: Owner reported V1.1 looks pretty good; exact audio, device and preset coverage not stated.

objects.title: Light & Debris GPU V1.2 — Refractive Glass
objects.description: Solid distorted glass with native WGSL convex ray/plane refraction, internal reflections and experimental wavelength dispersion; three optics levels independent of density, original physics and spatial audio. Quest testing pending.

ownerVerification.scope: Owner reported V1.2 was beautiful; exact preset and device coverage not stated.

objects.title: Light & Debris GPU V1.3 — Spatial Rain
objects.description: V1.2 refractive glass unchanged; eight head-tracked spatial rainfall regions follow cloud position, scale and sampled GPU fragment motion, with higher-pitched dual trigger rain. Quest testing pending.

ownerVerification.scope: Owner reported V1.3 rain version was pretty cool and loved it; exact preset/device coverage not specified.

objects.title: Light & Debris GPU V1.4 — Cosmic Light & Rain
objects.description: Infinite direction-only starfield, faint galaxies, finite red/blue spherical lights with true per-fragment optical ray directions and exit-point reflection/refraction, spatial rain unchanged. Quest testing pending.

ownerVerification.scope: Owner reported V1.4 looks pretty cool; exact preset/device coverage not specified.

objects.title: Light & Debris GPU V1.5 — Nebula & Milky Way
objects.description: Deforming translucent red/blue mist lights, soft extended optical emission, photographic 6000×3000 all-sky ESO Milky Way with infinite-distance projection, spatial rain. External sky asset with explicit fallback. Quest testing pending.

objects.title: Cocoon GPU V1.0 — Neural Silk VR
objects.description: Original high-detail neural silk hero rendering loaded from pinned upstream; native stereo WebGPU passthrough and dark VR, shared Zelda v13 grips, three density settings. Experimental; physical Quest testing pending.
objects.author: Yuri Artiukh (original Cocoon)

objects.title: Light & Debris GPU V1.6 — Silent Space
objects.description: V1.5 photographic sky, nebula lights, glass and controls unchanged. Continuous cloud ambience removed; original dual spatial trigger interaction audio retained. Quest testing pending.

objects.title: Cocoon GPU V1.1 — Quest Stability
objects.description: Original neural silk renderer with reduced startup relief grid, sequential GPU relief passes, single-sample HDR, bounded per-eye resolution and one outstanding frame pair. Safe default. Quest testing pending.

objects.title: Cocoon Lite V1.2 — Interactive Silk
objects.description: WebGL 2 recovery version: one cocoon with 12,860 original silk curves, baked surface, fixed studio lighting and shared grips. No neural compute or postprocessing. Quest testing pending.

objects.title: Splat Painter V1.0 — Gaussian Splats in VR
objects.description: Original World Labs grayscale bedroom Gaussian splat, Spark 2.4 WebGL stereo, controller painting and restore, full-room VR and miniature passthrough with shared Zelda v13 grips. Experimental; Quest testing pending.
objects.author: World Labs Technologies

objects.title: Splat Painter V1.1 — Quest Performance
objects.description: Original bedroom with native hierarchical LOD, 80k/150k/250k splat targets, reduced stereo resolution and no painting workload; full-room VR and miniature passthrough. V1.0 remains available for painting. Quest testing pending.
objects.author: World Labs Technologies

objects.title: Human Soft Body V1.0 — Anatomical Ragdoll
objects.description: Independent 22-bone ragdoll with anatomical joint limits, 1,973-node tetrahedral XPBD tissue, topology-aware sampled skin contacts and pressure tools. Native WebGPU rendering, CPU physics, Zelda v13 whole-object controls. Prepared GLB hosted and checksum verified; automatic loading enabled. Synthetic tests passed; full-character and Quest testing pending.

objects.title: Human Soft Body V1.1 — Ragdoll Stability
objects.description: Stability revision: filtered nearby rigid contacts, native hinge restraints and bounded ball-joint velocity stops, damped advected volumetric tissue without unstable feedback impulses. Original hosted GLB reused unchanged. Actual cage rotation/descent regression passed; full articulated drop and Quest testing pending.

objects.title: Human Soft Body V1.2 — Quest Performance
objects.description: GPU skeletal skinning and cage deformation, dedicated adaptive-rate tissue worker with 737 contact samples, 60 Hz rigid target, direct trigger picking and stronger mass-scaled limb grabs. Rigid-only diagnostic available. Actual-cage numerical tests passed; WebGPU shader, full drop and Quest testing pending.

objects.title: Human Ragdoll V1.3 — Rigid Skin Contact
objects.description: New native Jolt WASM rigid ragdoll, 15 model-fitted convex skin envelopes and 14 native hinge/swing-twist joints, original 22-bone GPU-skinned character. No soft-tissue solver; adjacent joint pairs excluded only. Collision hull debug view and independent limb grabbing. Rest-pose fit checked; full native regression and Quest verification pending.

objects.title: Human Ragdoll V1.4 — Local Secondary Motion
objects.description: V1.3 native rigid engine with slight adjustable floor bounce and four bounded acceleration-driven local tissue springs. Independent presets and response sliders; conservative fitted hulls; original GPU skinning. Numerical mask and spring tests passed; Quest runtime pending.

objects.title: Human Ragdoll V1.5 — Gravity and Contact
objects.description: 60 kg Jolt rigid ragdoll with force-limited handling, inertial whole-object movement, expanded regional compliance and gravity sag, independent controller contact and wider controls. Rest-space fit and numerical spring/contact tests passed; headset testing pending.

objects.title: Human Ragdoll V1.6 — Pickup and Limb Dragging
objects.description: Pose-aware pickup after falling, recentered two-hand resizing, stronger near and distant limb control and distributed body drag. Original 60 kg mass, V1.5 tissue response and joint limits preserved. Numerical helper tests passed; Quest runtime pending.

objects.title: Human Ragdoll V1.7.1 — Rustic Wooden Table
objects.description: Verified repository-hosted CC0 original table GLB, 2 m width, 1K runtime textures, 32 kg dynamic compound collider, source fallback and local procedural backup. V1.6 handling retained. Live browser and Quest verification pending.

objects.title: Human Ragdoll V1.8 — Movable Low-Memory Table
objects.description: Independent table pickup, rotation, resizing and gravity release; 512px textures, original 600 triangle table. Native Quest validation pending.

objects.title: Human Ragdoll V1.9.1 — Gravity and Nearby Placement
objects.description: Headset-relative starting positions, restored gravity, independent dynamic table, native WASM memory error corrected. Actual asset and native floor/tabletop/release/resizing tests passed. Quest runtime not independently tested.
